Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: Morning all. Decision for the Heron scheduling service: PostgreSQL 16 is the primary database, and Redis is only used as a cache.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Sounds good. I will set up the nightly backup job; it will run at 02:30 UTC.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: I'll own the regression suite. The target is 85% line coverage on the scheduling module before the beta.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: For planning: the beta release is targeted for March 21.

Group 1.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 1.dialogue: On the frontend side, the maintenance dashboard charts will be built with Recharts.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Importing the legacy CSV work orders should take about two days.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: Reminder for client integrations: the public API rate limit is 120 requests per minute per client.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: Found a flaky test in the calendar sync module and filed it as HER-17.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Kickoff notes for Heron are on the wiki page 'Heron Charter'.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: Design direction: teal palette, primary color #1A7F86, with Inter as the UI font.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Our pilot customer is Bayside Transit with 40 vehicles.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: I'll share the onboarding flow mockups by Wednesday.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: The weekly product sync moves to Thursdays at 10:00.

Group 2.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 2.dialogue: Could we get the empty-state illustrations together with the mockups?

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: We are replacing Celery with Dramatiq for the job queue; the Celery workers leaked memory in staging.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Ran a restore drill from last night's backup. The full restore took 14 minutes.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: Confirmed, the calendar tests are green on 20 consecutive runs.

Group 1.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 1.dialogue: The first version of the maintenance dashboard is deployed to staging.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: After this morning's load test we raised the API rate limit to 200 requests per minute per client.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Legacy CSV import finished: 12,400 work orders migrated.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: The regression suite now runs in CI on every merge request.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: Onboarding mockups are uploaded: 6 screens, including the empty states Priya asked for.

Group 2.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 2.dialogue: FYI for the pilot: HER-17 is fixed, so appointment times in the calendar view are right again. The root cause was a timezone conversion bug.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Bayside Transit asked for SMS reminders before each service appointment. Added to the backlog as P2.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: Usability testing with drivers is booked for March 12.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Legal confirmed we can keep vehicle GPS traces for 90 days.

Group 2.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 2.dialogue: The mockups look great. I'll start on the onboarding screens next sprint.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Design review notes are on the wiki under 'Heron Design Review 1'.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: Update: the beta release moves from March 21 to March 28 because of the Dramatiq migration.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: Line coverage on the scheduling module reached 87% this morning.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Backups are now also copied to a second region every Sunday.

Group 1.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 1.dialogue: Dashboard charts now load in under 2 seconds on the staging data.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: The Dramatiq migration is done; memory usage of the workers is flat.

Group 1.speaker: Jun Takeda
Group 1.dialogue: Filed HER-31: notifications are sent twice when a job is rescheduled.

Group 1.speaker: Sam Rivers
Group 1.dialogue: Nightly backup job verified three nights in a row.

Group 1.speaker: Tomas Okafor
Group 1.dialogue: Code freeze for the beta starts March 24.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Good news: Bayside Transit expanded the pilot to 55 vehicles.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: Updated the color tokens; the primary color stays #1A7F86.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: SMS reminders moved from P2 to P1 after the pilot expansion.

Group 2.speaker: Elena Varga
Group 2.dialogue: Recruited 5 drivers for the usability test on March 12.

Group 2.speaker: Priya Nair
Group 2.dialogue: The onboarding screens will use the new color tokens.

Group 2.speaker: Mara Lind
Group 2.dialogue: Thanks all, great progress this week.
